import json
import primitive_api as api

def compact(obj, limit=12):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: obj[k] for k in list(obj)[:limit]}
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return [compact(x, limit) for x in obj[:limit]]
    return obj

ctx = api.get_task_context()
print("TASK_CONTEXT:", json.dumps(compact(ctx), default=str)[:2500])

world = api.observe_world()
print("WORLD_KEYS:", list(world) if isinstance(world, dict) else type(world))
print("WORLD_SUMMARY:", json.dumps(compact(world), default=str)[:3500])

inv = api.list_inventory()
print("INVENTORY_COUNT:", len(inv))
print("INVENTORY:", json.dumps(compact(inv), default=str)[:2000])

acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
print("ACCESSIBLE_COUNT:", len(acc))
print("ACCESSIBLE:", json.dumps(compact(acc), default=str)[:3500])

for q in ("Yugo", "spectrometer"):
    res = api.list_nearby_objects(query=q)
    print(f"NEARBY_{q}_COUNT:", len(res))
    print(f"NEARBY_{q}:", json.dumps(compact(res), default=str)[:2500])

print("SUCCESS:", json.dumps(compact(api.check_success()), default=str)[:1500])

import json
import primitive_api as api

def msg(r):
    if isinstance(r, dict):
        return {k: r.get(k) for k in ("valid_action","error","success","completed","lastActionMessage") if k in r}
    return str(r)[:300]

# Move toward spectrometer (NE of us). Try north first then east.
for d in ["east","north","north"]:
    r = api.move_direction(d)
    print(d, msg(r))

acc = api.list_accessible_objects()
print("FACING/ACC:", json.dumps([(o['uuid'],o['name'],o['description']) for o in acc if o['name']!='floor']))

nb = api.list_nearby_objects(query="spectrometer")
print("SPEC_NEARBY:", json.dumps([(o['uuid'],o['direction'],o['distance']) for o in nb]))

loc = api.observe_world().get('agentLocation')
print("LOC:", loc)
